This Lease Agreement made the 2025-12-3 , by and between Mrs. Patty Fay mD [name of lessor], of 51323 Unique Village [street address]. State of California , hereinafter referred to as "Lessor", and Weimarke [name of lessee], of BA7BA Godfrey Grove [street address], State of California , hereinafter referred to as "Lessee", collectively referred to herein as the "Parties", agree as follows:
1.DESCRIPTION OF LEASED PREMISES:
The Lessor agrees to lease to the Lessee the following described square feet (SF) of _____ Warehouse _____ located at 52577 Hailey Corners [street address], State of California.
2. TERM OF LEASE:
The term of this Lease shall be for a period of 4 year(s) 2 month(s) commencing on the 31 day of Decembe 2025 day of Decembe 2025 , and expiring at Midnight on the 3 day of March 2030
3. BASE RENT:
The net monthly payment shall be 9750 dollars (\\(9750) per month. A security deposit of 2317 dollars (\\)2317)
is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the commencement of the Lease and each monthly installment payable thereafter on the 1st day of each month
4. Options to Renew (Check one):
Lessee may not renew the Lease.
The Lessee may have the right to renew the Lease with a total of renewal period(s) with each term being year(s) month(s) which may be exercised by giving written notice to Lessor no less than 60 days prior to the expiration of the Lease or renewal period.
